game.title: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
game.notes: Genesis Mode — Nintendo-exclusive, no native achievement list exists on Switch or Switch 2. Confirmed no paid DLC was ever released for this game (unlike Breath of the Wild's Expansion Pass), so no `dlc` bonus list is included. Content is treated as identical between Switch and Switch 2 — confirmed no exclusive gameplay feature exists on Switch 2, only performance improvements, a second save slot, and a companion app, consistent with the Breath of the Wild precedent. Two proactive re-verification passes were run before design (mirroring the successful approach used for Breath of the Wild) after initial research hit the same shared search-tool budget exhaustion; nearly every load-bearing fact was resolved to medium/high confidence — see dossier.json's `reverifiedFacts`. One important departure from Breath of the Wild: this game DOES have real missable content (three one-time bosses that cannot be rematched — Moragia, Sludge Like, and Master Kohga after his side adventure — plus non-replayable quests and non-respawning chests). Only Master Kohga's fight is represented as a trophy (TOTK-014, flagged missable) since it's tied to clearly-optional side content; Moragia is mandatory main-quest content so is not flagged missable despite also being unrematchable, and Sludge Like was excluded entirely due to insufficient confirmed detail about its context. The Korok Seed trophy is capped at 421 seeds (the confirmed practical threshold for maxing all inventory slots) rather than the full 1,000 available, applying the same Rule 20 lesson learned from the Breath of the Wild audit: the remaining ~579 seeds have no further mechanical benefit. Exact totals for the Hyrule Compendium (509), map completion percentage weighting, and Autobuild schematic cap remain unconfirmed or only medium-confidence, so no trophy cites those specific numbers — verification relies on visual/menu completion state instead. Moragia's exclusivity to the Goron questline (vs. an equivalent existing for other regions) is not explicitly confirmed by any source, only inferred from absence of evidence — trophy text avoids claiming this exclusivity outright. Post-audit fixes: added TOTK-032/TOTK-033 covering the Dragon's Tears/Geoglyphs system (12 memories forming the game's central narrative mystery), which the first audit pass correctly flagged as a major representation gap — Rule 3 requires the list to represent the game well, and this is arguably its most identity-defining piece of content. Also corrected a reversed item name ('Light of Blessing', not 'Blessing of Light') and removed two unsupported embellishments from verification text (an invented 'All's Well' reward item name, and a fabricated Koltin completion-confirmation claim) that the dossier did not actually support.

trophies.name: A New Arm
trophies.description: Complete the Great Sky Island, obtaining Ultrahand, Fuse, Ascend, and Recall.
trophies.verification: All four core abilities appear in the ability menu, and Link is free to descend to Hyrule.

trophies.name: First Light
trophies.description: Complete your first Shrine of Trials.
trophies.verification: The shrine is marked completed on the map, and a Light of Blessing is added to the inventory.

trophies.name: A Growing Legend
trophies.description: Find your first Korok Seed.
trophies.verification: The seed is added to the Key Items inventory.

trophies.name: Into the Depths
trophies.description: Activate your first Lightroot.
trophies.verification: The surrounding area of the Depths map is revealed, and the Lightroot becomes a fast-travel point.

trophies.name: Down Below
trophies.description: Discover your first cave and defeat its Bubbulfrog.
trophies.verification: The cave's map icon is marked cleared, and a Bubbul Gem is added to the inventory.

trophies.name: Sky High
trophies.description: Activate your first Skyview Tower.
trophies.verification: Both the Sky and Surface maps reveal new terrain around the tower.

trophies.name: Cataloged
trophies.description: Register your first entry in the Hyrule Compendium.
trophies.verification: The entry appears filled in the Compendium menu.

trophies.name: Back-Alley Bargain
trophies.description: Trade Poes at a Bargainer Statue for the first time.
trophies.verification: The Bargainer Statue's trade menu opens and an item is exchanged for Poes.

trophies.name: Stick 'Em Up
trophies.description: Fuse a material to a weapon for the first time.
trophies.verification: The fused weapon appears in the weapon wheel with the material attached.

trophies.name: Handy Work
trophies.description: Use Ultrahand to build a working vehicle or contraption for the first time.
trophies.verification: The completed build functions as intended (e.g. moves under power) after exiting Ultrahand.

trophies.name: Instant Replay
trophies.description: Use Autobuild to recreate a previous Ultrahand creation for the first time.
trophies.verification: The saved design is instantly reconstructed from the Autobuild menu.

trophies.name: Fairy's Blessing
trophies.description: Unlock your first Great Fairy Fountain.
trophies.verification: The Great Fairy emerges from the fountain and offers her armor upgrade services.

trophies.name: Stone Colossus
trophies.description: Defeat Moragia atop Death Mountain during the Goron regional questline.
trophies.verification: Moragia's defeat triggers the quest's next story beat.

trophies.name: One-Time Offer
trophies.description: Defeat Master Kohga during his side adventure encounter.
trophies.verification: The side adventure featuring Master Kohga is marked complete in the Adventure Log.

trophies.name: Vow of the Wind
trophies.description: Defeat Colgera in the Wind Temple, earning the Vow of Tulin, Sage of the Wind.
trophies.verification: The Vow of Tulin appears in the item menu, and the Wind Temple is marked freed.

trophies.name: Vow of the Water
trophies.description: Defeat Mucktorok in the Water Temple, earning the Vow of Sidon, Sage of Water.
trophies.verification: The Vow of Sidon appears in the item menu, and the Water Temple is marked freed.

trophies.name: Vow of the Fire
trophies.description: Defeat Marbled Gohma in the Fire Temple, earning the Vow of Yunobo, Sage of Fire.
trophies.verification: The Vow of Yunobo appears in the item menu, and the Fire Temple is marked freed.

trophies.name: Vow of the Lightning
trophies.description: Defeat Queen Gibdo in the Lightning Temple, earning the Vow of Riju, Sage of Lightning.
trophies.verification: The Vow of Riju appears in the item menu, and the Lightning Temple is marked freed.

trophies.name: Full Stock
trophies.description: Find enough Korok Seeds to fully expand your Weapon, Bow, and Shield inventory slots with Hestu.
trophies.verification: Hestu confirms all three inventory categories are fully expanded.

trophies.name: Well Traveled
trophies.description: Find every well in Hyrule, completing Fera's "Where Are the Wells?" quest.
trophies.verification: The quest is marked complete in the quest log, and no well icon remains unmarked on the map.

trophies.name: Full Coverage
trophies.description: Activate every Skyview Tower, revealing the full Sky and Surface maps.
trophies.verification: Every region of the Sky and Surface maps is revealed.

trophies.name: Full Bloom
trophies.description: Unlock all four Great Fairy Fountains.
trophies.verification: Every Great Fairy is active at her fountain, and all four offer their armor upgrade services.

trophies.name: Monster Hunter
trophies.description: Defeat a Gleeok.
trophies.verification: The Gleeok's defeat is confirmed by the materials it drops.

trophies.name: Apex Predator
trophies.description: Defeat a Lynel.
trophies.verification: The Lynel's defeat is confirmed by the materials it drops.

trophies.name: Vow of the Spirit
trophies.description: Defeat the Seized Construct in the Spirit Temple, earning the Vow of Mineru, Sage of Spirit.
trophies.verification: The Vow of Mineru appears in the item menu, and Mineru's Construct becomes summonable.

trophies.name: Crisis at Hyrule Castle
trophies.description: Complete the "Crisis at Hyrule Castle" quest by confronting the threat within.
trophies.verification: Defeating the threat at the Sanctum triggers the game's climactic story sequence.

trophies.name: The Demon King's End
trophies.description: Defeat Ganondorf and his dragon form, completing the main story.
trophies.verification: The ending cutscene plays and the credits roll.

trophies.name: Master of Shrines
trophies.description: Complete every Shrine of Trials in the game.
trophies.verification: The shrine count on the save-file loading screen reaches its maximum, and no shrine icon remains uncompleted on the map.

trophies.name: Illuminator
trophies.description: Activate every Lightroot in the Depths.
trophies.verification: The Lightroot count on the save-file loading screen reaches its maximum, and the entire Depths map is lit.

trophies.name: Cave Diver
trophies.description: Clear every cave by defeating its Bubbulfrog.
trophies.verification: No cave remains unchecked on the map.

trophies.name: Master Compendium
trophies.description: Fill every entry in the Hyrule Compendium.
trophies.verification: Every category page in the Compendium shows no empty silhouette slots remaining.

trophies.name: A Tear in Time
trophies.description: View your first Dragon's Tear memory.
trophies.verification: The memory plays and is added to the Adventure Log.

trophies.name: The Whole Story
trophies.description: Recover every Dragon's Tear memory, including the final one shed by the Light Dragon.
trophies.verification: Every memory appears recorded in the Adventure Log, with none remaining unfound.

trophies.name: Hero Reforged
trophies.description: Earn every other trophy.
trophies.verification: All other trophies earned.
